title: When two letters make one sound: sh, ch and th
examples: Why do two letters make one sound?

explain.say: Here is a secret: sometimes two letters hold hands and make just one sound. Look at the word ship. It has four letters. But listen carefully: it has only three sounds.

draw.text: When two letters make one sound: sh, ch and th

explain.say: Look at the first part glowing: s and h together. They make the shhh sound, like when you ask a baby to be quiet. Put a finger on your lips and say it with me.
Now the rest: i, the first sound in insect, then p, the first sound in pig. Tap three times, one tap for each sound, and blend them. Ship! Did you hear it?
Swap the first part for c and h together. They make the sound in a sneeze: a-choo! Now the word is chip. Can you hear the change?
Last one: t and h together make the first sound in thumb. Put your tongue gently between your teeth and blow. Now it says thin. Amazing, you know three letter teams! Can you find one on a sign today?

faq.a: A digraph is two letters that make one sound. Di means two, and graph means written. sh, ch and th are all digraphs.
Put a finger on your lips, like asking someone to be quiet, and push air out: shhh. It is the first sound in shop and ship.
Think of a sneeze: a-choo! It is the first sound in chip and cheese.
Put your tongue gently between your teeth and blow, like at the start of thumb. In words like this and that, add your voice too.

faq.q: How do I spot letter teams when I read?
faq.a: Look for s, c or t with an h after it. Draw a little line under the two letters, so your eyes see them as one sound. A teacher or grown-up can help you hunt for them.
asks: How do I find sh in a word?

facts: The word ship has four letters but only three sounds.
In sh, ch and th, the letter h joins another letter to make a brand new sound.

quiz.say: How many sounds are in the word chip?
quiz.why: c and h make one sound, then i, then p: three sounds.

wrong.0: Chip has a sound for ch, one for i and one for p.
wrong.2: Chip has four letters, but c and h make just one sound.

quiz.say: Which letters make the first sound in thumb?
quiz.why: t and h together make the first sound in thumb.

wrong.0: s and h make the shhh sound, like in ship.
wrong.1: c and h make the sneeze sound, like in chip.
